primary_adjustment.missing_or_other: missing adjustment value; primary population is not subset on geology because geology is an adjustment rather than the response or source feature
primary_adjustment.model_encoding: two dummy indicators oceanic and mixed with continental reference, plus missingness indicator; if continental absent in the final primary population, use sorted observed nonmissing levels with first as reference
primary_adjustment.same_rule_for_mammal_macro: only if the same response-independent geology source can be crosswalked prospectively; otherwise taxon-specific availability is reported and geology is not fabricated

if_public_API_not_exposed.fallback: use exact published Zizka/PNAS supplementary geology table only if an independently auditable public artifact containing entity_ID and geology is located and frozen in a later revision
